## Description

Provide a brief summary of the changes introduced by this pull request and the motivation behind them.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (`fix`)
- [ ] New feature (`feat`)
- [ ] Documentation update (`docs`)
- [ ] Performance improvement (`perf`)
- [ ] Code refactoring (`refactor`)
- [ ] Tooling or CI/CD (`ci` / `chore`)

## Pre-Merge Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow the Conventional Commits specification.
- [ ] Code passes formatting check: `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- [ ] Code passes linter check: `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- [ ] All unit, integration, and doctests pass: `cargo test --all-targets`
- [ ] Documentation has been updated where relevant.
